# Draft:Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati

Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati is an Indian Hindu priest and a head of the Jyotish Peeth of Badrinath.
Consecration of Ram Mandir
He opposed consecration of Ram Mandir, saying it is against Hinduism to perform consecration of an incomplete temple.
Shankaracharya title
He was coronated as Shankaracharya on 12 October 2022. His use of "Shankaracharya" title is a part of a legal dispute. The Mela Authority, under the Uttar Pradesh government, sent him a notice in January 2026 regarding the authenticity of his use of "Shankaracharya" title. The notice was condemned by Indian National Congress, Samajwadi Party and Hindu Mahasabha.
